action.action_summary: Re-derived each S12 candidate's evidence fresh from the canonical Experience Layer, re-ran the E12/E23/E33+S-series/S1/S4 duplication-and-conflict check, and mechanically checked whether every evidence record's own full JSON text references the same real-world root-cause facts (gpu_available, PRODUCTION_VALIDATION_HOLD.json, GPU/ComfyUI) that ground the already-adopted S4 Principle.

result.note: The S12 candidate mechanically traces back to the same real GPU/ComfyUI root cause the S4 Principle already covers -- correctly REJECTED as not independent rather than treated as a second, separate signal.

cause.root_cause_summary: A signal built entirely from two Experience records that exist specifically because a change-detection gate compared the same real infrastructure fact twice will, by construction, reference that same fact both times -- a structurally new (goal_ref, experience_kind) grouping key is a necessary but not sufficient condition for a genuinely new improvement signal; the underlying cause has to be checked too, or the same real dependency would get counted, and potentially later adopted, as two unrelated principles.

lesson: Validating a "new" signal requires checking not just whether its grouping key is unseen, but whether its evidence is causally independent of every already-adopted Principle -- a meta-level echo of an existing, already-covered real dependency is not a second improvement signal, even when it clears every structural/duplication check on its own terms.
